Q: How to call a python API protected by XSUAA? A:

It might be worth reading through https://community.sap.com/t5/technology-blog-posts-by-sap/demystifying-xsuaa-in-sap-cloud-foundry/ba-p/13468237 - normally, XSUAA bindings to applications will have scopes defining access to applications. For applications to access XSUAA scopes in other applications, foreign scope references will need to be added to the calling application's XSUAA binding definition as described in https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-developer-guide-for-cloud-foundry-multitarget-applications-sap-web-ide-full-stack/application-security-descriptor-configuration-syntax

Q: How to integrate web app with SAP EWM RF functions A:

If your ECC system is on 630_740 or newer, there are some available interfaces from SAP's Mobile Add-On that will handle providing oData Services to applications built on SAP's Mobile Development Kit, serving the data via instances of SAP Mobile Services applications on the BTP. If you add the correct customization to these layers, you might be able to get them to perform the functions on the ECC system you're looking for.

Q: UPDATE statement with multiple joins including a ranged join A:

I think the following approach, based on a correlated subquery, does what you ask for:

update orders o
set country = (
    select il.country_code
    from login_history lh
    inner join ip2location il on lh.ip >= il.ip_from and lh.ip_to < il.ip_to
    where lh.created <= o.timestamp and lh.uid = o.uid
    order by lh.created desc limit 1
) 
where o.country_id is null

This searches for the latest login_history for the same user whose date prior or equal to the order timestamp, and recovers the corresponding country.

Q: Update value in MariaDB with join A:

You should use a nested subquery with an aggregated result for the join

  UPDATE tabC c 
  JOIN  (
    SELECT c_id, IFNULL(SUM(payment),0) tot_payment
    FROM tabB
    GROUP BY c_id
  ) b ON b.c_id = c.id 
  SET c.total = (c.v1 - c.v2 - c.v3) - b.tot_payment 
  WHERE c.id = 983;

Q: Update a row based a joined table in MariaDB? A:

Use backticks in MySQL but do not apply these to the combined table and alias they must be treated as separate items

UPDATE `user_login` a 
    LEFT OUTER JOIN `p_pegawai` b
    ON a.id_pegawai = b.id  
    SET a.password = 'Keluarga1'  
    WHERE b.NIP = '195812'

Q: Add to output before exporting to variable A:

You can use SUBSTRING to extract the required string from uniqueId and then add 76561197960265728 to form communityId.

[U:1: => This constitutes of 5 characters, so SUBSTRING start position is from 6th character and then the extract length can be the entire length of uniqueId minus 5 character minus the ] i.e 1 which is at the end.

SUBSTRING(uniqueId, 6, LENGTH(uniqueId) - 5 -1)

Sample Query

    select playerId, uniqueId, game,
    cast(SUBSTRING(uniqueId, 6, LENGTH(uniqueId) - 5 -1 ) as UNSIGNED) + 76561197960265728 as communityId
from  players
where playerId = 562;

Outputs

playerId uniqueId game communityId
562 [U:1:18893661] cstrike 76561197979159389
